name: EasyTP
description: Server-side commands: /sethome, /home, /tpa, /tpahere, /tpaccept and /spawn, moderation (temporary bans, mutes, warnings), automatic world backups and game modes: survival PvP with hearts, money, shops, leaderboards and clans, plus duels, OneBlock islands and BoxPvP. Players do not need to install the mod.
